title: Disable and remove
summary: yoke projects retire hides a project without deleting history. It refuses with project_retirement_blocked while open items, created or executing deployment runs or held claims remain, naming each claim with its holder session and the yoke claims work release --claim-id N --reason TEXT command a steering-seat holder runs to free a claim whose holder ended. Settle the named blockers, then retry; yoke projects unretire restores the project.
